description: Send keys or a command to a tmux pane, then capture its output. Target format: 'session:window.pane'. Use enter=false for raw tmux key sequences like 'C-c', 'Escape', or arrow keys — these are not shell commands and must not have Enter appended. Use enter=true (default) for shell commands. Set wait_ms higher for long-running commands; 0 captures immediately before output appears. WARNING: this executes arbitrary commands in your shell — only use with trusted input.

enter.description: Press Enter after keys (default: true). Set false for raw key sequences like C-c, Escape, arrow keys.

keys.description: Command or key sequence (tmux notation: 'C-c', 'Escape', 'Up', etc.)

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait before capturing (default: 400). Set higher for slow commands, 0 to capture immediately.

name: send_keys
